capabilities: Render citations as Obsidian wikilinks that double as formatted citations
Import and update literature notes from Zotero items and annotations
Search and rank Zotero items for citation insertion while typing
Compile and export notes as markdown, DOCX, ODT or PDF
Import DOCX and ODT documents as notes with linked citations
disambiguation: Not a general reference manager; it organises writing around citations, literature notes and document compilation.
extras: Core citation features work offline with just a .bib file; document import/export runs external programs and is desktop-only. The plugin documents its network use in a table and states it collects no telemetry. It recognises notes created by ZotLit and can convert them, though it does not integrate with ZotLit. Beta versions are distributed via BRAT.
intentEvidence: ScholarWeft is a fork of Bripey Citation Suite by 112345brian
problem: Obsidian citation plugins either link to a literature note or render pandoc citations, not both, and Zotero-driven academic writing usually has to leave the vault.
